subject: integration DELTA4: TLS/WLS + D8F18H dispatch PASS; one real flat-line gap
body:
Current-source host work only; no phone/build/publish. New independent tests in my worker:
1) n2mb_v2_job_test TLS/WLS via real bridge selector5/7 + fake JM, decoded with pinned Mesa v9_pack.h: TLS-only64 (tls_size=2, no-WLS marker 0x80000000), WLS-only256 (instances=1, scale=9), mixed64/256; oversized word17/18=32769 refused before submit; TLS/WLS BOs appear in submit handles and are released after wait; forced command-allocation failure after TLS/WLS alloc releases both and does not submit. 156 checks/0 required.
2) D8F18H-linear1 real lowering SPIR-V (final-742cdf3d evidence) recompiled byte-identically to TGP2 sha a179cc46…, TLS=32/WLS=0, 5 manifest records (UBO, declared-combined tex+sampler at binding2, dummy sampler, storage image), dispatched through real n2mb bridge/fake JM with 3 descriptors; LOCAL_STORAGE v9 unpack shows tls_size=1 (32B), TLS base/address-mode, no-WLS marker; BOs held at submit/released after wait. 156/0.
3) draw v3 through real n2mb_draw_v3: vertex_base=3 and base_instance=2 land at FAU 1664+64/+68; flat triangle sets TILER_CONTEXT.first_provoking_vertex=1. PASS.
FINDING for render: flat line topology is not refused. n2r_validate_v3 returns 0 and n2mb_draw_v3 submits for primitive=TEGU_GENERIC_DRAW_LINES (1), vertex_count=4, opts.version=1 flags=FLAT_SHADING|WRITE_VERTEX_BASE|WRITE_BASE_INSTANCE. Required integration failure until n2r_validate_impl explicitly rejects FLAT_SHADING with line topology (arch9 no DRAW flat bit). Minimal: build/deepseek-parallel-20261025/workers/integration_tests/n2mb_draw_v2_test.c, “flat line topology accepted…”. ABI gate now derives resource size/offsets from Rust+C (no handwritten 488 table) and checks four level arrays vs TEGU_AIR_COMPUTE_MAX_LEVELS; 488 is recorded, not asserted as a magic number. Full suite/--candidate pending the render guard.
